purpose: Real cost model. A backtest without these numbers is fiction.
verify_note: Rates change. Re-verify against your broker's contract note and the exchange circular before trusting a backtest. Rates below reflect Budget 2026 (STT on F&O effective 1 April 2026) plus standard NSE charges.

assumptions.note: GST is NOT charged on STT or stamp duty.

equity_delivery.dp_charge_note: Depository participant charge per sell scrip per day, approx. Verify with broker.

equity_futures.stt_note: Raised from 0.02% to 0.05% in Budget 2026, effective 1 April 2026.

equity_options.stt_note: Raised from 0.10% to 0.15% on premium in Budget 2026, effective 1 April 2026. Exercise STT also 0.15%.

worked_examples.basis: Rs 1,00,000 round-trip turnover, one buy and one sell of equal value

slippage.note: Costs above are taxes and fees. Slippage is separate and usually larger.
slippage.rule: Double the modelled slippage and re-run the backtest. If expectancy goes negative, the edge was never real.

breakeven.formula: total_cost_bps / 10000 must be exceeded by the average gross move
breakeven.equity_intraday_example: 8.46 bps round trip means a 0.085% move just breaks even before slippage. Add 10 bps slippage and the bar is ~0.19%.
breakeven.implication: High-frequency daily trading at ~30 round trips a month pays roughly 3% of capital per year in costs alone.
